% The face class's poster preset on an invented poster: a titled face and its blocks in columns
% spanning the poster's column grid.
\documentclass{ltface}
\begin{document}
\begin{frame}{Invented Lattice Posters}
\begin{columns}[T]
\begin{column}{0.38\textwidth}
\begin{block}{Alder block}
Birch is the block's first paragraph, long enough to wrap across a column of the poster's grid
at its own size, which takes it to a second line and a third.

Cedar is its second paragraph.
\end{block}
\begin{block}{Dogwood block}
Elm is the second block's body.
\[ a \wedge (b \vee c) \ge (a \wedge b) \vee (a \wedge c). \]
\end{block}
\end{column}
\begin{column}{0.2\textwidth}
\begin{block}{Hazel block}
Juniper is the right column's body.
\begin{itemize}
\item Kilo, the first item.
\item Lima, the second.
\end{itemize}
\end{block}
\end{column}
\begin{column}{0.4\textwidth}
\begin{alertblock}{Mike block}
November closes the poster.
\end{alertblock}
\end{column}
\end{columns}
\end{frame}
\end{document}
